mapper.select: SELECT id,delivery_version,delivery_mode mode,delivery_status state,pickup_registered_at,delivered_at,evidence_json evidence,remark FROM custom_delivery_record WHERE custom_order_id=#{order} ORDER BY delivery_version DESC
SELECT id,delivery_version,delivery_mode mode,delivery_status state,pickup_registered_at,delivered_at,evidence_json evidence,remark FROM custom_delivery_record WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_delivery_record SET delivery_status='delivered',delivered_at=#{at},acceptance_deadline_at=DATE_ADD(CAST(#{at} AS DATETIME(3)),INTERVAL 48 HOUR), version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND delivery_status='awaiting_pickup_confirmation'
mapper.select: SELECT o.id,d.id delivery,d.delivery_version FROM custom_order o JOIN custom_delivery_record d ON d.id=o.current_delivery_record_id WHERE o.order_status='pending_acceptance' AND o.acceptance_status='running' AND o.acceptance_deadline_at<=#{at} ORDER BY o.acceptance_deadline_at,o.id LIMIT 100

SELECT id,custom_order_id order_id,version,request_status state,original_promised_date original_date,requested_promised_date requested_date, request_reason reason,evidence_json evidence,resolution_summary decision_note,admin_case_id case_id FROM custom_order_extension_request WHERE custom_order_id=#{order} AND request_status!='draft' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id

SELECT id,custom_order_id order_id,version,request_status state,original_promised_date original_date,requested_promised_date requested_date, request_reason reason,evidence_json evidence,resolution_summary decision_note,admin_case_id case_id FROM custom_order_extension_request WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM custom_order_extension_request WHERE pending_order_guard=#{order}
SELECT id FROM custom_order_extension_request WHERE custom_order_id=#{order} AND request_status='draft'

SELECT a.id,a.custom_order_id order_id,a.version,a.after_sale_status state,a.source_delivery_record_id delivery_id,a.problem_summary problem,a.evidence_json evidence, a.requested_solution,a.resolution_type,a.resolution_summary resolution_note,COALESCE(r.custom_goods_refund_amount_fen,0) goods_refund_fen,COALESCE(r.freight_refund_amount_fen,0) freight_refund_fen, a.refund_order_id refund_id,r.refund_status,a.resolution_delivery_record_id replacement_delivery_id,a.after_sale_type issue_type,a.admin_case_id case_id FROM custom_after_sale_request a LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON r.id=a.refund_order_id WHERE a.custom_order_id=#{order} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id

SELECT a.id,a.custom_order_id order_id,a.version,a.after_sale_status state,a.source_delivery_record_id delivery_id,a.problem_summary problem,a.evidence_json evidence, a.requested_solution,a.resolution_type,a.resolution_summary resolution_note,COALESCE(r.custom_goods_refund_amount_fen,0) goods_refund_fen,COALESCE(r.freight_refund_amount_fen,0) freight_refund_fen, a.refund_order_id refund_id,r.refund_status,a.resolution_delivery_record_id replacement_delivery_id,a.after_sale_type issue_type,a.admin_case_id case_id FROM custom_after_sale_request a LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON r.id=a.refund_order_id WHERE a.id=#{id}

SELECT a.id,a.custom_order_id order_id,a.version,a.after_sale_status state,a.source_delivery_record_id delivery_id,a.problem_summary problem,a.evidence_json evidence, a.requested_solution,a.resolution_type,a.resolution_summary resolution_note,COALESCE(r.custom_goods_refund_amount_fen,0) goods_refund_fen,COALESCE(r.freight_refund_amount_fen,0) freight_refund_fen, a.refund_order_id refund_id,r.refund_status,a.resolution_delivery_record_id replacement_delivery_id,a.after_sale_type issue_type,a.admin_case_id case_id FROM custom_after_sale_request a LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON r.id=a.refund_order_id WHERE a.active_order_guard=#{order}
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_order o JOIN custom_delivery_record d ON d.id=o.current_delivery_record_id SET o.order_status='pending_acceptance',o.acceptance_status='running', d.acceptance_deadline_at=IF(#{replacement},DATE_ADD(d.delivered_at,INTERVAL 48 HOUR),TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,o.acceptance_remaining_seconds,#{at})), o.acceptance_deadline_at=IF(#{replacement},DATE_ADD(d.delivered_at,INTERVAL 48 HOUR),TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,o.acceptance_remaining_seconds,#{at})), o.acceptance_paused_at=NULL,o.acceptance_remaining_seconds=NULL,o.updated_at=#{at},o.version=o.version+1,d.updated_at=#{at},d.version=d.version+1 WHERE o.id=#{id}

UPDATE admin_case SET case_status='closed',active_case_key=NULL,resolution_summary=#{note},resolution_code='resolved',closed_at=#{at},closed_by_admin_user_id=#{actor},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND case_status!='closed'
mapper.select: SELECT id,custom_order_id order_id,version,request_status state,original_promised_date original_date,requested_promised_date requested_date, request_reason reason,evidence_json evidence,resolution_summary decision_note,admin_case_id case_id FROM custom_order_extension_request WHERE request_status!='draft' AND request_status=#{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_order_extension_request WHERE request_status!='draft' AND request_status=#{status}

SELECT a.id,a.custom_order_id order_id,a.version,a.after_sale_status state,a.source_delivery_record_id delivery_id,a.problem_summary problem,a.evidence_json evidence, a.requested_solution,a.resolution_type,a.resolution_summary resolution_note,COALESCE(r.custom_goods_refund_amount_fen,0) goods_refund_fen,COALESCE(r.freight_refund_amount_fen,0) freight_refund_fen, a.refund_order_id refund_id,r.refund_status,a.resolution_delivery_record_id replacement_delivery_id,a.after_sale_type issue_type,a.admin_case_id case_id FROM custom_after_sale_request a LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON r.id=a.refund_order_id WHERE 1=1 AND after_sale_status=#{status} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_after_sale_request WHERE 1=1 AND after_sale_status=#{status}
